# Warmane profile fixtures

Author: Neil Mitchell

Last modified by: Neil Mitchell

Public Warmane responses inspected on September 7, 2026:

- Mothrmonster on Lordaeron: Paladin summary, dual specs, glyphs, category
  navigation, achievement summary/General category, statistics summary,
  reputation, collections and empty arena history.
- Azyva on Lordaeron: Druid dual-spec talent layout with class-specific nodes.
- Cavern of Time spell 20332: the linked WotLK rank-five description for
  Seals of the Pure.

HTML fixtures retain character-sheet markup and the matching document title.
Scripts, styles, session metadata and unrelated navigation were removed.
Category JSON retains the public content fragment. These are parsing evidence,
not claims about the characters' current builds. Browser tests substitute an
invocation-owned illustrative character and write only to a loopback database.
